Gut Health & Dietary Fiber Guidelines
Fiber supports gut bacteria and digestive regularity. Fiber Guidelines: -
Target 25 to 30 grams of fiber daily for adults. - Increase fiber intake
slowly over 2-3 weeks to minimize initial gas or bloating.
